text: Bang & Olufsen A/S is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen (XCSE: BO); its 2025/26 annual report confirms the listing, and press reporting lists New Sparkle Roll and Denmark's Dyvig Holdings as investors holding more than 10% of the capital and voting rights.
